# ElysonSweets (FO Food Products Germany) - LLMs.txt
> ElysonSweets is the official distributor of FO Food Products in Germany and Europe, specializing in B2B supply for HoReCa (Hotels, Restaurants, Cafés), Patisseries, Gelaterias, and Bakeries.

## About ElysonSweets & FO Food Products
- **Company**: Elyson Sweets GmbH i.G.
- **Location**: Sirius Business Park, Wilhelm-Ruppert-Straße 38 / F8, 51147 Köln, Germany
- **Contact**: info@elysonsweets.de | +49 176 41533653 | https://www.elysonsweets.de
- **Managing Director**: Ahmet Seker
- **Target Market**: Business-to-Business (B2B) - Gastronomy, HoReCa, Wholesale, Bakeries, Ice Cream Parlors
- **Primary Brand Partner**: FO Food Products (over 20+ years of high-standard food & beverage ingredient manufacturing)
- **Logistics & Delivery**: Ambient, chilled, and frozen logistics across Germany and the European Union. Carton & pallet-level deliveries with B2B discount tiers.

---

## Core Product Categories (FO Food Products)

### 1. Barista & Beverage Solutions
- **Premium Coffee Syrups & Flavored Syrups**: Vanilla, Caramel, Hazelnut, White Chocolate, Coconut, Almond, Chai, and fruity cocktail syrups.
- **Cocktail Mixes, Bases & Purées**: Concentrated fruit purees, mojito/cocktail bases, iced tea bases.
- **Foamer & Barista Essentials**: Professional cocktail foamer, latte art essentials, and milk texture enhancers.
- **Powdered Drinks & Frappés**: Hot chocolate, chai latte, salep, frappe powders, milkshakes.
- **Turkish & Specialty Coffee**: Authentic Turkish coffee blends, espresso beans, filter coffee.

### 2. Saucen & Toppings (Dessert, Ice Cream & Coffee Saucen)
- **Topping & Decor Sauces**: Chocolate, Caramel, Raspberry, Strawberry, Forest Fruit, Pistachio, Mango, White Chocolate toppings for ice cream, waffles, and cheesecakes.
- **Special Sauces & Pastes**: Special Pistachio Sauce, Hazelnut Creme, Chocolate Hazelnut sauces designed for professional pastry chefs and baristas.
- **Fruit Pastes & Concentrated Purées**: 100% natural aroma fruit pastes for bakery, pastry fillings, and ice cream manufacturing.

### 3. Pastry, Bakery & Gelato Ingredients
- **Patisserie & Baking Ingredients**: Glazes, pastry creams, stabilizers, cake mixes, sugar paste, and aroma compounds.
- **Ice Cream & Gelato Bases**: Gelato bases, ripple pastes, variegates, and cone dip sauces.

## B2B Ordering & Commercial Terms
- **Eligibility**: B2B only (§14 BGB) - cafes, coffee shops, restaurants, bakeries, ice cream parlors, caterers, and wholesalers.
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: Flexible starting from 1 carton per SKU.
- **Discounts**: Volume discounts, tiered pricing, and pallet rebates available upon registration.
- **Payment Terms**: Prepayment, SEPA, and invoice payment (5 days net for verified partners).
- **Shipping**: Germany & EU-wide delivery with temperature-controlled logistics when required.
